description: Forim wears a dark blue knee-length open-front wool kaftan with restrained pale geometric woven trim over an ivory linen long shirt with blue geometric embroidery at the split neckline and hem. A heavy dark brown wool cloak is pinned at both shoulders by round clasps. A plain brown leather belt has a small buckle and a long hanging strap with round fittings. Brown trousers, dark lower-leg wraps with crossed ties and brown closed leather shoes complete the outfit. His long swept-back blonde hair is uncovered.
